title: Household Limits on Parking Licenses per Lease
content:
A lease may hold several Parking Licenses, one vehicle each, up to 3 across all parking products and up to each product's own limit of licenses per lease.

## Standard

1. A parking request is accepted only when the lease's open licenses are below both the household cap and the product's own cap, and the household cap never exceeds the lease's adult applicants plus one.
2. Waitlisted requests count toward the caps.
3. The open licenses of a lease are its Parking Licenses in waitlisted, active, suspended or notice-given status, counted in total (against the household cap) and per parking product (against that product's own cap). A terminated license or a withdrawn request is not an open license.

## Basis of the count

- The count is taken from the system records of the lease the request would attach to: the status and parking product of each of that lease's Parking Licenses, and the number of adult applicants recorded on the lease.
- Licenses of any other lease do not enter the count.

## The household cap in figures

The household cap is 3, and it never exceeds the lease's adult applicants plus one; it is therefore the lower of 3 and the adult applicants plus one.

| Adult applicants on the lease | Adult applicants plus one | Household cap |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2 | 2 |
| 2 | 3 | 3 |
| 3 or more | 4 or more | 3 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical leases)

- **Case A.** One adult applicant; the lease holds one active Surface Unreserved Permit and one waitlisted request for a Covered Carport Space. Open licenses: 2. Household cap: the lower of 3 and 2, which is 2. The open licenses are not below the cap, so a further request is not accepted.
- **Case B.** Two adult applicants; the lease holds one active Surface Reserved Space and one terminated Surface Unreserved Permit. Open licenses: 1 (the terminated license does not count). Household cap: 3. A request for a Structured Garage Space is below the household cap; it is accepted when the lease's open Structured Garage Space licenses are also below that product's own cap.
- **Case C.** Two adult applicants; the lease holds one active EV Charging Reserved Space. A second request for the EV Charging Reserved Space is accepted only if the lease's open licenses of that product are below the product's own cap, whatever room remains under the household cap.
